question:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.

Though Pradeep _____________ for Jamaica, he landed up in Nigeria.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **set out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrasal verb** "set out"** is used when someone begins a journey or starts traveling towards a particular destination.
 
• This fits the context of Pradeep intending to go to one place but ending up in another.
